verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for an automation platform like Make, but the evidence pack documents no bulk or batch endpoints and no mass-edit capability in the API, MCP server, or UI. The closest item is scheduled processing of a queued backlog of webhook requests, which is a different feature from user-invoked bulk operations across many items. That earns no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
